name: master-session
description: A validator session (/master-session:start) that briefs worker sessions (/master-session:subchat), persona subagents (/master-session:subagent) and workflows (/master-session:workflow), verifies what they deliver and merges it, with a live status pane (/master-session:info), a band above the prompt and seven personas (implementer, refactorer, reviewer, QA verifier, design checker, researcher, designer), each a skill and an agent.
